# Contributing

The contribution rules for the Firestarter project are on the wiki
[Contributing](https://github.com/henols/firestarter/wiki/Contributing) page.

That page tells you where to report a problem and where to open a pull request. It also tells you
how the project manages a change to more than one repository.

Issues go to the project tracker in
[henols/firestarter](https://github.com/henols/firestarter/issues), not to this repository.
Refer to [SUPPORT.md](https://github.com/henols/firestarter_app/blob/main/SUPPORT.md).
